circuit.name: Sepic DC-DC Converter
circuit.description: Single-Ended Primary Inductor Converter for non-inverting step-up/step-down with continuous input current. Converts 12V input to 12V output (1:1 at D=0.5) with positive polarity maintained.

requirements.requirement: Startup transient from 12V input to 12.0V output.
Steady-state operation. Verify output voltage regulation at 12.0V.

data.name: rise_time_10_90
data.spice_command: TRIG [VOUT] VAL={0.1*{criteria.target_vout}} RISE=1 TARG [VOUT] VAL={0.9*{criteria.target_vout}} RISE=1

requirements.requirement: Efficiency across load points with loss breakdown
Stress & thermal margins for key devices
